q1_issues.issue: The habitual plural "on Sundays" is rendered as a single weekday slot (Time (sk_work $x) (Weekday sunday)) with no accompanying (Every (sk_work $x) 1 week), although the frequency rule says a named slot implies its cycle and mandates that companion atom — as emitted, the recurrence carried by the plural is lost.

q2_gaps: desire / control verbs with a non-finite "to V" complement ("wants to work", "tried to leave", "refused to sign") — Propositional attitudes is explicitly restricted to a finite clausal complement, so nothing decides between sealing the complement under Theme (what this parse does), reifying it at top level as the causation-flavored-verb bullet prescribes, or the inception pattern's separate Ongoing activity witness

bare-plural habitual time adjuncts ("on Sundays", "in the mornings", "on weekends") — the frequency section's triggers are all explicit ("every Monday", "every two weeks", "twice a week"), so it is not stated whether a bare plural weekday names a recurrence slot and takes the (Every e 1 week) cycle atom

negative indefinite pronoun as a quantified subject ("no one") — the quantifier table and QuantifierPhrase companion are specified for a determiner on a noun or group, and the person-classing rule only for anaphoric personal pronouns; nothing licenses ranging "no one" over (Member $x person) as a strength-0 rule or bounds its contextual domain
notes: Experiencer for the subject of "want" is correct by the progressive test, and the dependent Skolem functions (sk_want $x)/(sk_work $x) are formed correctly; sealing the complement keeps the desire non-veridical, which is the right semantics even though the instruction set does not license it for infinitival complements.
